lessons_used: Helpful changes: Flow reorderings, targeted functional hints (photo quality, path helper, account security), select clean layouts (card carousel, single-click identity), key desktop flows (summon, visibility/control), and specific hotkey copy.
Harmful changes: Major structural overhauls (docking setup flow, split personality redesign), spotlight and split view layouts, interactive practice flows, and certain copy changes.
No effect seen: Wait time, progress, and status indicators, background notifications, desktop prep or tutorial screens, and incentive badges consistently showed no clear effect.
Predictions too high: High predictions (+8.0% or above) consistently overestimated actual impact, frequently resulting in no clear effect or negative drops.

Predictions too low: Major winning changes—especially desktop visibility/control flows, shortcut hotkey copy, summon flows, security hints, and story reordering—far exceeded low or negative predictions.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Hotkey Control Cheat Sheet Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated onboarding wrap-up screen showcasing key desktop hotkeys and visual shortcuts for controlling, hiding, and interacting with the desktop companion.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints about users being confused on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after finishing onboarding.

new_hotkey_cheatsheet.headline: Master Desktop Companion Controls
new_hotkey_cheatsheet.body: Press Alt+P to summon or hide your pet anytime. Double click to interact or open pet chat.

guard.reason: Valid addition of an onboarding wrap-up screen following home_intro.

candidates.score_note: Desktop prep/tutorial screens consistently showed no clear effect.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Multi Style Creation Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns photo upload with explicit visual aspect ratio guidelines and clear lighting tips to prevent custom pet generation errors.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (64.2%) and support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results.

upload_photos.headline: Upload High Quality Pet Photo
upload_photos.body: For best generation results, use clear lighting with your pet centered in the frame.
upload_photos.hint: Ensure face is fully visible without strong shadows.

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[1]': a tip_carousel cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

candidates.title: Account Sign-In Session Persistence Verification Flow
candidates.change: Introduces an explicit account session verification indicator during sign-in to guarantee companion data persistence across app restarts.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Secure Account Sign-In
sign_in.body: Sign in to keep your pet and preferences synced across all your devices permanently.
sign_in.hint: Your pet state is linked securely to your authenticated account session.

guard.reason: Valid enhancement to the sign-in screen adding session persistence reassurance.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support complaints via identity persistence, but new flows require release cost.

candidates.title: Pre-Adoption Story Path Reorder Sequence
candidates.change: Reorders the opening sequence by presenting the path selection choice immediately prior to story introduction to streamline early decision making.
candidates.why: Path selection median time is short (8s) but mean is long (514s), indicating some users get stuck before choosing.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Sign-In Existing Pet Identity Notice Hint
candidates.change: Displays an inline security reassurance hint on the sign-in screen confirming that signing in protects existing pet data from being lost.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after re-authenticating.

sign_in.hint: Signing in anchors your companion identity safely to your account profile.

guard.reason: Valid inline hint update on the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Account security targeted hints are proven helpful and low cost to implement.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Pet Generation Interactivity Status
candidates.change: Shows dynamic background generation status and estimated completion time on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Waiting screen in home step has high mean duration (2336s) causing user uncertainty during pet creation.

waiting.headline: Bringing Your Companion To Life
waiting.body: Your pet is being crafted. Desktop placement will trigger automatically when ready.

guard.reason: Valid addition of dynamic generation status and wait estimate.

candidates.score_note: Status and wait time indicators consistently showed no clear effect.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Finalize Action Copy
candidates.change: Updates adoption certificate button and headline copy to emphasize immediate desktop availability upon completion.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate at 64.2%.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Confirm your companion's name to finalize adoption and bring them to your desktop immediately.

guard.reason: Valid copy update on the adoption certificate screen.

candidates.score_note: High step drop, but adoption copy changes have historically yielded -4.2% drop.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Compact Grid Selection Layout
candidates.change: Switches pick_friend selection layout to list mode with quick-view preview badges for faster adoption choice.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops significantly (64.2%), requiring a clearer presentation of pet choices.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Select the pet personality and style that fits your desktop setup.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign for pet selection.

candidates.score_note: Targeting high drop step, but adoption layout changes historically performed poorly (-1.5%).

candidates.title: Home Intro Quick Desktop Test Launch Callout
candidates.change: Adds a prominent welcome badge and action prompt to test pet desktop interactions immediately upon entering home intro.
candidates.why: Support emails noted confusion on how to interact or talk to pets once onboarding finishes.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Your companion is now active on your desktop screen. Click below to try your first interaction.

guard.reason: Valid addition of interactive welcome prompt on home_intro.

candidates.score_note: Incentive badges and intro callouts consistently show no positive effect.

candidates.title: Background Generation Notification Toggle
candidates.change: Enables desktop ready notification option on the waiting screen so users know when their pet is loaded without staring at the window.
candidates.why: Mean time in home waiting screen is 2336s, leading users to leave the app window while generation completes.

waiting.hint: You will receive a notification when your desktop pet is ready to interact.

guard.reason: Valid notification option addition on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Background notifications show no clear effect overall in previous lessons.

lessons_next: Helpful changes: Flow reorderings, targeted functional hints (photo quality, path decision helper, account security and restore), clean minimal layouts (card carousel, single-click identity), key desktop flows (summon, visibility/control), shortcut hotkey copy, and interactive waiting status updates consistently yielded significant wins.

Harmful changes: Major structural flow overhauls (docking setup, split personality redesign), intrusive spotlight and split view layouts, interactive practice flows, and cheat sheet screens consistently resulted in drops or early test stops.

No effect seen: Dedicated tutorial or environment prep screens, background completion notifications, incentive badges, and static waiting hints or carousels repeatedly showed no statistically clear effect.
Predictions too high: High predicted gains (+8.0% or higher) consistently overstated actual impact, frequently resulting in no clear effect or severe negative performance.
Predictions too low: Major winning changes—especially shortcut hotkey copy, account security and restore hints, story reordering, and desktop control flows—far exceeded low or negative predictions.
